name: Zhou Yucheng
source:
Ophelia's new tenant but Joe is by no means her regular tenant. He can't remember anything happened beyond two years ago. He once explained, "probably there isn't anything worthy of remembering", but deep down, he's worried if he has memory loss.

He studies in the same university with Raina. They were once dating each other but they seem to have broken up recently, about which Joe is rather anxious.
